verdict.rationale: Grafana ships AI features such as Grafana Assistant, so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only documents Grafana acting as an MCP server for outside agents (hosted Cloud MCP Server and the open-source mcp-grafana). That is the server role, not the ability to plug third-party MCP servers into Grafana, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
